reason: Current path: HyperFrames -> sharp. Installed HyperFrames uses sharp for the explicit remove-background command on user-selected image/video frames, snapshot description resizing, and captured-SVG rasterization; md2vid does not invoke these optional paths during normal Markdown generation or release checks, but its HyperFrames passthrough can expose them to user-chosen media or sites. Compensating constraint: use these optional commands only with trusted local media and trusted capture targets until remediation. HyperFrames declares a sharp range that excludes patched releases; forcing a 0.x minor/native ABI override is not proven compatible with HyperFrames, libvips bindings, or cross-platform release gates in this scoped task. Remove this exception by upgrading HyperFrames once upstream accepts and tests a compatible sharp range, then validate the exact package, HyperFrames, and native release gates before expiry.

Current paths: HyperFrames -> adm-zip and HyperFrames -> ONNX Runtime -> adm-zip. Installed HyperFrames creates publish archives from trusted local project files, parses remotely fetched .lottie ZIPs only during explicit website capture, and ONNX Runtime parses vendor NuGet packages during installation; normal md2vid Markdown generation and release checks do not accept uploaded ZIPs or invoke remote capture. Compensating constraint: capture only trusted sites/.lottie assets and install dependencies only from the configured npm registry until remediation. HyperFrames and ONNX Runtime both declare adm-zip ranges that exclude patched releases; a direct override changes the archive parser beneath two parents and is not proven compatible by this task's framework and native release gates. Remove this exception by upgrading HyperFrames once upstream accepts and tests a compatible adm-zip range, including its ONNX Runtime path, then validate the exact package, HyperFrames, and native release gates before expiry.
